c74object.name: touch.master
c74object.digest: Global Theme Master and Preset Morphing Matrix for Touch Suite
c74object.description: The central theme and preset management hub for the Touch JSUI Suite. Broadcasts unified palettes, geometry dimensions, glass panel characteristics, and inspector styles in real time to all listening components (touch.hslider, touch.vslider, touch.button, touch.numticker, and touch.ummanu). Features an interactive 4-page canvas inspector, floating spectrum color picker, and a multi-row preset matrix with continuous interpolation morphing and external JSON storage.

inlet.digest: Trigger broadcast, preset controls, and attribute configuration
inlet.description: Accepts bang to force a theme sync and outlet dump, preset management messages (presets, add_row, sub_row), or configuration messages to set theme parameters.

outlet.description:
Emits a formatted sequence of attribute messages when a theme is committed, recalled, or banged, allowing patch cords to update non-listening Max objects or record automation:
- Object Colors & Geometry: bg_color, border_color, text_color, highlight_color, border_radius, border_thickness, border_extension
- Glass Panel: panel_glass_inner, panel_glass_outer, panel_border_color, panel_border_radius, panel_border_size, panel_glass_spread
- Special Elements: popup_dot_color, slider_rail_color, slider_handle_color, decimal_color, mode_color, slider_rail_breadth
- Inspector Popups: pop_bgcolor, attr_bg_color, attr_border_color, attr_slider_color, attr_text_color

method.name: bang
method.description: Commits all current styling variables, writes them to the persistent dictionary, updates all wireless bus subscribers immediately, and streams attribute messages out Outlet 0.

method.name: presets
method.description: Opens, closes, or toggles the floating Theme Presets Matrix window. An optional argument of 1 or 0 explicitly opens or closes the window. Also accepts the alias preset_popup.

method.name: add_row
method.description: Appends an additional row of preset slots (with its own dedicated row morph slider) to the Presets Grid window (maximum 6 rows).

method.name: sub_row
method.description: Removes the bottommost row from the Presets Grid window (minimum 1 row). Also accepts the alias subtract_row.

method.name: quick_tags
method.description: Accepts a space-delimited list of words (e.g. quick_tags NEON DARK GLASS STAGE ACID) to populate the one-click category tag buttons inside the preset naming dialog.

method.name: embed_preset
method.description: Internal patcher persistence method. Takes a slot index integer followed by a serialized JSON string representing a complete theme snapshot.

method.name: clear_bus
method.description: Clears all registered subscriber function pointers from the global touch_theme_bus table.

attribute.name: active_page
attribute.description:
Selects which category of theme controls is displayed on the main canvas:
0 = Objects (Body, Border, Text, Highlight, Radii, Line Width)
1 = Panels (Glass Inner, Glass Outer, Panel Border, Spread)
2 = Special (Popup Dot, Slider Rail, Knob, Decimals, Mode Prefix)
3 = Popups (Inspector Background, Attribute Cell BG, Borders, Sliders, Text)

attribute.name: glide
attribute.description: Global flag enabling velocity-sensitive proximity easing and glide physics across compatible Touch Suite sliders.

attribute.name: preset_cols
attribute.description: Number of preset slot columns in the floating Presets Grid window (clamped between 2 and 8, default: 5).

attribute.name: preset_rows
attribute.description: Number of preset slot rows in the floating Presets Grid window (clamped between 1 and 6, default: 1). Each row includes an independent horizontal morph slider.

attribute.name: quick_tags
attribute.description: Space-separated list of preset title suggestions displayed in the modal preset capture card.

attribute.name: border_radius
attribute.description: Corner rounding radius in pixels broadcast to all Touch buttons, sliders, and tickers (0.0 to 25.0).

attribute.name: border_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke line width in pixels for reticle brackets across all Touch objects (0.5 to 6.0).

attribute.name: border_extension
attribute.description: Length in pixels of corner bracket extension arms (0.0 to 40.0).

attribute.name: panel_border_radius
attribute.description: Corner rounding radius in pixels broadcast to glass backdrop panels (0.0 to 50.0).

attribute.name: panel_border_size
attribute.description: Stroke width in pixels for glass panel outlines (0.0 to 5.0).

attribute.name: panel_glass_spread
attribute.description: Diffusion spread radius in pixels for multi-layered glass gradient fills (5.0 to 500.0).

attribute.name: slider_rail_breadth
attribute.description: Guide wire stroke thickness in pixels broadcast to all Rail and Ribbon sliders (0.5 to 25.0).
